== Exact published English Set 11 text ==
The remaster replaces the search tax and free Used Interrupts with agendas, a Dark Force icon at Conference Room and additional battle destiny with another Council Member. The printed attribute band replaces Force-Sensitive with Influence 3. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 29].
